listings.title: Jasa Installasi & Pemasangan Mesin Packaging Otomatis
listings.description: Jasa installasi, pemasangan, dan komisioning mesin packaging otomatis (sealer, filler, shrink wrap, labeling). Tim engineer bersertifikat siap membantu dari unloading, positioning, piping, wiring, hingga trial run dan training operator. Melayani pabrik makanan, farmasi, kosmetik, dan FMCG di seluruh Indonesia. Free konsultasi dan survey lokasi.

listings.description: Jasa potong dan ukir laser CO2 130W untuk akrilik, MDF, kayu, karet, dan kertas. Juga tersedia laser fiber untuk marking dan cutting logam (stainless steel, baja, aluminium). Akurasi tinggi, hasil rapi tanpa rough edges. Cocok untuk signage, nameplate, gantungan kunci, undangan, lampu dekoratif, dan produk promosi.

listings.description: Jasa pemotongan dan ukiran CNC router presisi tinggi untuk berbagai material: kayu jati, kayu sengon, MDF, akrilik, PVC foam board, dan HPL. Mesin CNC 3 axis 1300x2500mm dengan spindle 3.2kW. Cocok untuk pembuatan partisi, furniture custom, sign board, panel dekoratif, dan souvernir. Menerima file AutoCAD, CorelDRAW, ArtCAM.

listings.description: Sewa excavator Komatsu PC200-8 lengkap dengan operator berpengalaman untuk proyek galian, pondasi, perataan lahan, dan pekerjaan konstruksi. Unit terawat dengan performa optimal. Harga sudah termasuk operator dan bahan bakar. Tersedia paket harian, mingguan, dan bulanan. Area Jawa Tengah dan sekitarnya.

listings.description: Tim teknisi berpengalaman 15+ tahun siap melayani service dan perbaikan mesin cetak offset semua merk (Heidelberg, Komori, Roland, Mitsubishi, KBA, Ryobi, Sakurai). Layanan meliputi: overhaul mesin, ganti bearing, setting registration, perbaikan sistem tinta dan air, kalibrasi. Garansi service 3 bulan. Tersedia kunjungan on-site seluruh Jawa.

listings.description: Jasa cetak offset berkualitas tinggi untuk brosur, flyer, poster, dan kartu nama. Mesin Heidelberg SM 52 4 warna dengan hasil tajam dan warna akurat. Minimal order 500 lembar, harga mulai Rp 150/lembar tergantung ukuran dan jumlah. Proses cepat 3-5 hari kerja. Tersedia coating glossy/doft.

listings.title: Nozzle Mesin Injeksi Plastik (Universal)
listings.description: Nozzle mesin injeksi plastik universal. Cocok untuk berbagai merk mesin injeksi (Haitian, Chen Hsong, JSW). Material baja tahan panas H13. Ukuran 5mm-12mm tersedia.
listings.descEn: Universal plastic injection machine nozzle. Compatible with various injection machine brands (Haitian, Chen Hsong, JSW). H13 heat-resistant steel. Available in 5mm-12mm sizes.

listings.title: Filter Oli Kompressor Atlas Copco (Original)
listings.description: Filter oli original Atlas Copco untuk kompressor seri GA30-GA90. Pack isi 3 pcs. Ganti setiap 2000 jam operasi. Menjaga kualitas oli dan umur kompressor.
listings.descEn: Original Atlas Copco oil filter for GA30-GA90 compressor series. Pack of 3. Replace every 2000 operating hours. Maintains oil quality and compressor lifespan.

listings.title: Sparepart Roller Offset Heidelberg (Set)
listings.description: Set roller mesin cetak offset Heidelberg SM 52. Termasuk dampening roller, inking roller, dan form roller. Material polyurethane dan rubber. Cocok untuk overhaul mesin cetak.
listings.descEn: Heidelberg SM 52 offset printing machine roller set. Includes dampening roller, inking roller, and form roller. Polyurethane and rubber material. Suitable for printing machine overhaul.

listings.title: Pisau CNC V-Bit Set 10pcs (Hard Carbide)
listings.description: Set pisau CNC V-Bit 10 pcs berbagai sudut (15°, 20°, 30°, 45°, 60°). Material tungsten carbide. Cocok untuk ukiran detail, signage, dan cutting MDF/akrilik. Cocok untuk CNC router 3018, 1325, 6040.
listings.descEn: 10pcs CNC V-Bit set with various angles (15°, 20°, 30°, 45°, 60°). Tungsten carbide material. Suitable for detailed engraving, signage, and MDF/acrylic cutting. Compatible with 3018, 1325, 6040 CNC routers.

listings.title: Concrete Mixer 350L Diesel Engine
listings.description: Mesin pengaduk beton (concrete mixer) kapasitas 350 liter. Penggerak engine diesel 7 HP. Drum baja tebal, frame kokoh. Cocok untuk proyek bangunan skala menengah.
listings.descEn: 350 liter capacity concrete mixer. 7 HP diesel engine drive. Thick steel drum, sturdy frame. Suitable for medium-scale construction projects.

listings.title: Excavator Komatsu PC200-8 Bekas
listings.description: Excavator Komatsu PC200-8 tahun 2015. Working hours 6500 jam. Kondisi baik, siap kerja. Bucket 0.8m³. Cocok untuk proyek galian, perataan lahan, dan konstruksi. Lokasi unit di Bekasi.
listings.descEn: Komatsu PC200-8 excavator year 2015. 6500 working hours. Good condition, ready to work. 0.8m³ bucket. Suitable for excavation, land leveling, and construction. Unit located in Bekasi.

listings.title: Mesin Planner Thicknesser 20 Inch 3 in 1
listings.description: Mesin kayu 3 in 1: planer, thicknesser, dan saw. Lebar kerja 20 inch (510mm). 3 pisau HSS. Motor 3 HP. Cocok untuk woodworking shop dan furniture maker. Kondisi baru.
listings.descEn: 3-in-1 woodworking machine: planer, thicknesser, and saw. 20 inch (510mm) working width. 3 HSS blades. 3 HP motor. Suitable for woodworking shop and furniture maker. New condition.

listings.title: Mesin Table Saw Sliding 3000mm + Scoring
listings.description: Meja potong kayu sliding table 3000mm lengkap scoring blade. Motor utama 5.5 HP, motor scoring 1 HP. Presisi potong tinggi, cocok untuk furniture factory dan workshop. Merk SCM.
listings.descEn: 3000mm sliding table saw with scoring blade. 5.5 HP main motor, 1 HP scoring motor. High cutting precision, suitable for furniture factory and workshop. SCM brand.

listings.title: Mesin Jahit Industri Juki DDL-8700 (1 Jarum)
listings.titleEn: Juki DDL-8700 Industrial Sewing Machine (1 Needle)
listings.description: Mesin jahit industri Juki DDL-8700 high speed 1 jarum. Untuk jahit lurus pada kain tipis hingga sedang. Kecepatan 4500 stitch/menit. Kondisi baru, garansi resmi. Cocok untuk konveksi kaos dan kemeja.
listings.descEn: Juki DDL-8700 industrial high speed sewing machine, 1 needle. For straight stitching on light to medium fabrics. 4500 stitch/min speed. New condition with official warranty. Suitable for t-shirt and shirt convection.

listings.title: Mesin Bubut Mini Table Top 180x300 (Bench Lathe)
listings.description: Mesin bubut mini bench lathe 180x300mm untuk hobi dan workshop kecil. Bisa bubut logam lunak, plastik, dan kayu. Dilengkapi 3-jaw chuck dan tailstock. Motor 550W. Cocok untuk pemula.
listings.descEn: 180x300mm mini bench lathe for hobby and small workshop. Can turn soft metal, plastic, and wood. Equipped with 3-jaw chuck and tailstock. 550W motor. Suitable for beginners.

listings.title: Mesin Bubut CNC 2 Axis Slant Bed Mazak QT-200
listings.titleEn: Mazak QT-200 2-Axis CNC Slant Bed Lathe
listings.description: Mesin bubut CNC 2 axis slant bed Mazak QT-200. Chuck 8 inch, spindle 4000 RPM. Fanuc 0i-TD control. Kondisi second import Jepang, sudah diperiksa teknisi. Garansi 3 bulan.
listings.descEn: Mazak QT-200 2-axis CNC slant bed lathe. 8 inch chuck, 4000 RPM spindle. Fanuc 0i-TD control. Used Japanese import, technician inspected. 3 month warranty.

listings.title: Mesin Bubut Logam Conventional WD6150 1500mm Swing 500mm
listings.description: Mesin bubut logam konvensional WD6150 swing 500mm, center distance 1500mm. Untuk bubut besi, baja, dan stainless steel. Kondisi bekas import China, masih bagus dan presisi. Cocok untuk bengkel dan workshop.
listings.descEn: WD6150 conventional metal lathe, 500mm swing, 1500mm center distance. For turning iron, steel, and stainless steel. Used Chinese import, still in good and precise condition. Suitable for workshops.

listings.title: Mesin Laser Fiber Marking 20W (Tanda Seri)
listings.description: Mesin laser marking fiber 20W portable untuk tanda seri, logo, QR code pada metal dan plastik. Area marking 110x110mm. Speed tinggi, presisi 0.001mm. Raycus source, EZCAD software.
listings.descEn: 20W portable fiber laser marking machine for serial numbers, logos, QR codes on metal and plastic. 110x110mm marking area. High speed, 0.001mm precision. Raycus source, EZCAD software.

listings.title: Mesin CNC Milling VMC 850 Second Import Jepang
listings.titleEn: Used Japanese Import CNC Milling VMC 850
listings.description: Mesin CNC milling vertical VMC 850 import Jepang (Mazak). Travel X=850 Y=500 Z=500mm. Spindle 8000 RPM, BT40 taper. Kondisi bagus, siap produksi. Cocok untuk mold making dan precision parts.
listings.descEn: Japanese import (Mazak) CNC vertical milling VMC 850. Travel X=850 Y=500 Z=500mm. 8000 RPM spindle, BT40 taper. Good condition, production ready. Suitable for mold making and precision parts.

listings.title: Mesin Laser Cutting CO2 1300x900 130W
listings.description: Mesin laser cutting CO2 130W area kerja 1300x900mm. Untuk potong akrilik, MDF, plywood, kain, dan kulit. Reci W4 tube, lensa focus ZnSe. Kontrol Ruida RDC6445G. Kecepatan potong hingga 800mm/s.
listings.descEn: 130W CO2 laser cutting machine with 1300x900mm working area. For cutting acrylic, MDF, plywood, fabric, and leather. Reci W4 tube, ZnSe focus lens. Ruida RDC6445G controller. Cutting speed up to 800mm/s.

listings.title: Mesin CNC Router Woodworking 1325 3 Axis
listings.description: Mesin CNC router 1325 3 axis untuk kayu, MDF, akrilik, dan aluminium composite. Area kerja 1300x2500mm. Spindle 3.2kW air cooling. Driver leadshine. Cocok untuk furniture, signage, dan craft.
listings.descEn: 1325 3-axis CNC router for wood, MDF, acrylic, and aluminum composite. 1300x2500mm working area. 3.2kW air cooling spindle. Leadshine driver. Suitable for furniture, signage, and craft.

listings.title: Mesin Extruder Pipa PVC 65mm
listings.description: Mesin extruder pipa PVC diameter 16-65mm. Lengkap dengan vacuum tank, haul-off, dan cutter. Produksi pipa air standar SNI. Mesin second import Taiwan kondisi siap pakai.
listings.descEn: 16-65mm diameter PVC pipe extruder machine. Complete with vacuum tank, haul-off, and cutter. SNI standard water pipe production. Used Taiwan import machine, ready to use.

listings.title: Mesin Blow Molding Botol 5L
listings.description: Mesin blow molding semi-otomatis untuk produksi botol HDPE/PP kapasitas 1-5 liter. Cocok untuk botol minyak, deterjen, dan bahan kimia. 1 cavity, produksi 400 botol/jam. Mudah dioperasikan.
listings.descEn: Semi-automatic blow molding machine for 1-5 liter HDPE/PP bottle production. Suitable for oil, detergent, and chemical bottles. 1 cavity, 400 bottles/hour production. Easy to operate.

listings.title: Mesin Shrink Wrap Tunnel L Sealer
listings.titleEn: L Sealer Shrink Wrap Tunnel Machine
listings.description: Mesin shrink wrap lengkap L-sealer dan tunnel pemanas. Untuk membungkus produk dengan film shrink PVC/POF. Cocok untuk kemasan produk elektronik, makanan, dan kosmetik. Tinggi tunnel adjustable.
listings.descEn: Complete shrink wrap machine with L-sealer and heating tunnel. For wrapping products with PVC/POF shrink film. Suitable for electronics, food, and cosmetics packaging. Adjustable tunnel height.

listings.title: Mesin Sublimasi Tinta 1.8m + Heat Press
listings.description: Mesin sublimasi tinta lebar 1.8m lengkap dengan heat press roll. Untuk produksi kaos, mug, kain, bendera. Hasil warna menyerap sempurna ke kain polyester.
listings.descEn: 1.8m wide sublimation ink machine complete with roll heat press. For t-shirt, mug, fabric, and flag production. Colors absorb perfectly into polyester fabric.

listings.title: Mesin UV Flatbed Printer 60x90cm A3+
listings.description: Mesin cetak UV flatbed A3+ untuk cetak langsung di akrilik, kaca, kayu, logam, dan berbagai material lainnya. Hasil cetak tahan gores dan UV. 6 warna + white ink. Cocok untuk souvenir dan signage.
listings.descEn: A3+ UV flatbed printer for direct printing on acrylic, glass, wood, metal, and various other materials. Scratch and UV resistant prints. 6 colors + white ink. Ideal for souvenirs and signage.

listings.title: Mesin Cetak Label Flexo 3 Warna
listings.description: Mesin cetak label flexo 3 warna untuk produksi stiker dan label kemasan. Kecepatan tinggi hingga 120m/menit. Dilengkapi die cutting inline. Cocok untuk industri makanan dan kosmetik.
listings.descEn: 3-color flexo label printing machine for sticker and packaging label production. High speed up to 120m/min. Equipped with inline die cutting. Suitable for food and cosmetics industry.

listings.title: Mesin Cetak Sablon Flat Screen Manual + Vacuum
listings.titleEn: Manual Flat Screen Printing Machine with Vacuum
listings.description: Mesin cetak sablon flat screen manual dengan sistem vacuum table. Area cetak 60x80cm, cocok untuk kaos, kertas, dan material datar lainnya. Frame alumunium ringan dan tahan karat.
listings.descEn: Manual flat screen printing machine with vacuum table system. 60x80cm print area, suitable for t-shirts, paper, and other flat materials. Lightweight and rust-proof aluminum frame.

listings.title: Mesin Cetak Digital Konika Minolta C3080
listings.titleEn: Konika Minolta C3080 Digital Printing Machine
listings.description: Mesin cetak digital Konika Minolta C3080 produksi tinggi. Cocok untuk cetak short run, variable data, dan personalisasi. Kualitas cetak setara offset. Mesin import Jepang kondisi istimewa.
listings.descEn: Konika Minolta C3080 high production digital printing machine. Ideal for short run, variable data, and personalization. Offset-equivalent print quality. Japanese import in excellent condition.
